title: Amazon connections
intro: Connect this seller account to Amazon. Credentials are encrypted on the server and never shown again.
mockBanner: Test mode: Amazon calls are answered by recorded sample data. Nothing reaches a real Amazon account.
noAccount.title: Create your first seller account
noAccount.body: A seller account is one Amazon selling partner in one region. You connect SP-API and the Ads API to it.
noAccount.viewer: No seller account is set up yet. Ask an owner or admin to create one.
account.name: Seller account name
api.spapiHelp: Orders, listings, inventory and finance. Enter the refresh token from self-authorizing your private app in Seller Central.
api.adsHelp: Campaigns, bids and reports. You sign in to Amazon and approve access for seller-hub.
syncUnknown: Sync status appears here once data sync is set up.
disconnectConsequence: The stored credential is deleted and syncing stops. Data already stored stays. To finish, also remove seller-hub's access in Seller Central or the Ads console.
spapi.tokenHelp: Paste it once. It is checked with Amazon, then encrypted. It is never displayed again.
spapi.success: Connected. This token can see {count} marketplace(s): {names}.
profiles.title: Ads profiles
profiles.intro: Pick which Ads profile belongs to which marketplace. Business dates follow the profile's time zone.
profiles.empty.title: Connected, but Amazon returned no profiles
profiles.empty.body: This Amazon login has no advertising profiles. Check that the account runs ads, then refresh.
profiles.name: Account
errors.refresh_token_invalid: Amazon did not accept this token. Check it was copied completely and that the app is still authorized.
errors.invalid_format: That does not look like a refresh token.
errors.state_invalid: This connection attempt expired or was already used. Start again.
errors.authorization_code_invalid: Amazon rejected the approval. Start again.
errors.amazon_app_not_configured: The Amazon application credentials are not set on this server yet.
errors.amazon_unreachable: Amazon could not be reached. Try again shortly.
errors.amazon_error: Amazon answered with an error. Try again shortly.
errors.amazon_throttled: Amazon is throttling requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.profile_marketplace_mismatch: That profile belongs to another country.
errors.unknown_marketplace: That marketplace is not available for this seller account.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
